Filled Cookies
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, December 4, 2009 - 12:56am

Ingredients




1 cup Lard
3 Eggs
1 teaspoon Baking soda
2 cups Brown sugar
4 cups Flour
2 tablespoons Water - cold
1 cup Raisins
1 cup Sugar
1 cup Water
1 tablespoon Flour

Preparation

1 Filling: Boil and cool. Put between cookies before baking. 2 Note: Combine ingredients for dough while filling is cooling. Roll out, cut, spread with filling. Bake in moderate 350 F. oven. 3 Serving: Number of 4 Servings: 1 Fat grams per serving:Approx. 5 Cook Time: Cholesterol per serving: Marks: P
